_docs._readme: All fields are documented here. Remove api_key and api_secret from this file — pass them via KRAKEN_API_KEY and KRAKEN_API_SECRET environment variables instead.

_mode_guide.recurring: Monthly DCA. A fixed fiat amount is deposited each month on deposit_day. The bot spreads buys evenly between each deposit. Use this when you add money regularly.
_mode_guide.lump_sum: One-time chunk. You deposit a large amount once and the bot spreads buys evenly until dca_end_date. Use this when you want to DCA a fixed sum over a bear market or defined window. Set deposit_day to any value — it is unused in this mode.

_docs.dca_end_date: Required when mode is 'lump_sum'. ISO date string (YYYY-MM-DD) marking the last day buys are allowed. The bot spaces buys evenly between now and this date using the available fiat balance. Must be in the future.
_docs.trading_pair: Kraken asset pair to trade, e.g. XBTCHF (BTC/CHF) or XXBTZUSD (BTC/USD).
_docs.deposit_day: Day of the month the scheduled buy runs (1-28). Defines the cycle boundary for recurring mode and for max_monthly_amount tracking. Unused in lump_sum mode.
_docs.buy_hour: Hour of the day (0-23) at which the scheduled buy executes on deposit_day (recurring) or startup (lump_sum).
_docs.crypto_amount: Amount of crypto to buy per order (in BTC). Each scheduled and dip buy uses this amount when dynamic_dca is disabled. Minimum on Kraken: 0.0001 BTC. When dynamic_dca is enabled this is the base/flat tier amount.
_docs.dip_threshold_percent: OBSOLETE when dynamic_dca is enabled. How far the price must drop below the last buy price to trigger an extra dip buy (e.g. 5 = 5%). Set high to reduce noise.
_docs.dip_buy_cooldown_hours: OBSOLETE when dynamic_dca is enabled. Minimum hours between two consecutive dip buys, to avoid over-buying during a crash.
_docs.poll_interval_seconds: How often the bot checks prices and conditions, in seconds (minimum 60).
_docs.max_price: Skip any buy if the current price is above this value (in fiat). Useful to avoid buying at ATH. Set to null to disable.
_docs.max_monthly_amount: Maximum fiat to spend per period (deposit_day to deposit_day in recurring, or per calendar month in lump_sum). Set to null to disable.
_docs.live_trading_enabled: Allow real orders. false = dry-run (no orders placed). The LIVE_TRADING_ENABLED environment variable overrides this setting when set. Changes require a restart.
_docs.exchange_credentials: NOT a config.json field. Kraken credentials come from the KRAKEN_API_KEY/KRAKEN_API_SECRET environment variables, or from the dashboard-managed secrets store (data/secrets.json, mode 0600) when the env vars are unset.
_docs.dynamic_dca: Optional dynamic amount adjustment. When enabled, the bot varies the buy size based on price change vs the last buy (or average buy). See _dynamic_dca_guide below.

_dynamic_dca_guide.enabled: Master switch. When true, every buy uses the tiered amount logic below and the legacy dip buy is disabled.
_dynamic_dca_guide.reference: Price reference for tier matching: 'last_buy' (default) or 'avg_buy'.
_dynamic_dca_guide.cooldown_hours: Minimum hours between two consecutive dynamic buys, to avoid over-buying during a crash. Applies to extra buys triggered by price drops; scheduled buys still run on schedule.
_dynamic_dca_guide.tiers: Array of tiers. Each tier has threshold_percent (price change vs reference), amount (crypto to buy, in the base asset), and enabled (bool). Tiers are matched from highest threshold down. amount 0 means 'skip'.
